name: Get dataset CSV stream
description: Get dataset CSV stream Retrieves the CSV content of a given dataset by alias or ID. GET /client/v4/radar/datasets/{alias}

name: List datasets
description: List datasets Retrieves a list of datasets. GET /client/v4/radar/datasets
context:
GET /client/v4/radar/datasets
Retrieves a list of datasets.
Optional: limit (query) — Limits the number of objects returned in the response.; offset (query) — Skips the specified number of objects before fetching the results.; datasetType (query) — Filters results by dataset type.; date (query) — Filters results by the specified date.; format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.

name: Get dataset download URL
description: Get dataset download URL Retrieves an URL to download a single dataset. POST /client/v4/radar/datasets/download
context:
POST /client/v4/radar/datasets/download
Retrieves an URL to download a single dataset.
Optional: format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.; body (body)
